product_brief.brief_description: Design a clean label whole-grain oat digestive biscuit containing at least 9% protein, at least 7% fibre, and crumbly snap texture. Requires wholesome toasted oat flavour, 9-month ambient stability, and raw material cost under 6.0 USD/kg. Avoid artificial leaveners and dairy butter.
